---
description: "Create a second original world and propose future mechanic ideas"
name: "07 - Create a second world"
argument-hint: "Optional: theme, palette, or mechanic emphasis"
agent: "agent"
---

Use the existing progression, level format, editor, and mechanics to create a second original world that demonstrates the game's content pipeline.

Inspect current world/stage data and the level editor first. Add content through the established format instead of hard-coding a second progression flow. Keep all names, art, audio, and level layouts original.

Implement:
- A distinct world identity expressed through a concise theme, visual palette, and environmental presentation that remains readable during precision movement.
- At least two short original stages, with a difficulty ramp and a mix of core navigation and mechanics already implemented.
- World/stage selection and unlock flow wired into the existing progression and save data.
- Any small editor or loader improvement required to author these stages, without broad unrelated redesign.

At the end, suggest 4-6 concrete future mechanics or world concepts that fit this game and explain each in one sentence. Ideas may include currents or gust patterns, switches and timed gates, moving bridges, gravity changes, rival/enemy behaviors, optional collectibles, or alternate routes. Treat these as proposals only; do not implement them in this task.

Acceptance criteria:
- The second world is reachable through normal progression, and both new stages can be edited and completed.
- Existing first-world progress and saves remain valid.
- Verify a build and the relevant progression/content checks; report the future ideas separately from implemented work.
